programs.title: Homestead Rescue
programs.desc: After Hurricane Helene obliterates a 100-year-old farmhouse in NC, a once self-sufficient family is left with nothing; the Raneys face their most urgent mission yet: to rebuild a fourth-generation homestead, making it 100% self-sustainable.

programs.title: Homestead Rescue
programs.desc: In California's fire country, a couple's dream homestead is on the brink of ruin; when Marty must leave early, Misty and Matt face the flames and an urgent fix, alone in a high-stakes rescue.
